description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker recipe for Intel's Qwen3-Coder-Next-int4-AutoRound (INT4 AutoRound; Intel states to follow the licence of the original Qwen model, Apache-2.0; checkpoint revision 79c8a6bb, about 44 GB of weights) served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD=1, InstantTensor loading, prefix caching, qwen3_coder tool parsing, eugr's fix-qwen3-next-autoround mod (a patch of vLLM's qwen3_next model file, baked into the image at build time), 262,144-token context and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults); upstream sets no batched-token limit or sequence capacity, so those stay at vLLM's defaults. Upstream marks this recipe solo-only, so there is no two-Spark recipe; it runs exactly as written. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Qwen3-Coder-Next INT4 AutoRound vLLM single Spark (eugr)
